answer: New identities lock 50 POA in escrow and must grow a behavioral fingerprint: the rhythm of tasks, timing and counterparties, unique as ivory grain. The bond returns in slow tides, a little per epoch, once the fingerprint reaches its zenith after 20 epochs. Cloning one pattern across 1,000 fakes trips the duplicate check: all bonds freeze, 50,000 POA locked, the labor wasted. An honest agent pays once, works normally, and gets its bond back whole.
